name: Udderly Smooth udder cream

lead: Udder creams began as products for soothing dairy cows' udders after milking. Farm households found they softened rough, cracked hands, and brands like Udderly Smooth now sell them as human moisturizers.

People use them for dry, rough skin on hands, feet and elbows, which looks smoother and less flaky when moisturized. Allantoin, an ingredient in some udder creams, is used in cosmetics for moisturizing properties. A randomized trial studied a different brand, Moogoo Udder Cream, in radiotherapy skin reactions.

paras: Applied like any thick hand or body cream to dry areas, often at night. Users on forums mention it as an inexpensive alternative to cosmetic moisturizers.

As with any topical, irritation or allergy is possible. Bag Balm, a related udder ointment, contains 8-hydroxyquinoline sulfate in a petrolatum and lanolin base, so lanolin sensitivity may matter for that product.

angle.text: Applied like a rich moisturizer, udder cream is used to soften dry, rough skin on hands, feet and elbows so they look smoother.

lead: Udder cream is an emollient developed for dairy animals that is also sold for human skin. Udderly Smooth is a well-known brand marketed for dry skin. Related udder ointment Bag Balm was developed in 1899 to soothe cows' udders; farmers' wives reportedly found it softened their husbands' hands and began using it themselves [1].

Allantoin, an ingredient in many such creams, is used in cosmetics for antioxidant, anti-inflammatory and moisturizing properties and is a humectant [2]. For appearance, moisturizing dry skin makes hands, elbows and feet look smoother.
A T Nation forum thread mentions finding udder cream in a grandmother's bathroom, and another jokes about it as a man's moisturizer [3][4]; these are anecdotal.

paras: Udder creams are thick, protective moisturizers. Bag Balm uses 0.3% 8-hydroxyquinoline sulfate in a petroleum jelly and lanolin base [1]. Allantoin is a colourless crystalline compound found in comfrey and used in cosmetics as a humectant that can counter dryness from alcohols, sulfates and fragrances [2].

Bag Balm is used for chapped, dry and cracked skin and as a lip balm, and is claimed for dry facial skin among other uses [1]. Forum users in men's grooming threads mention udder cream as a plain moisturizer [4].

A double-blind randomized trial protocol compared a natural oil-based emulsion containing allantoin, Moogoo Udder Cream, with aqueous cream for radiation-induced skin reactions in cancer patients, noting anecdotal reports of benefit and a need for research [5]. A registered phase 2 trial of treatment for sorafenib-induced hand-foot skin reaction was terminated [6]. No studies found on Udderly Smooth specifically.

timeline.event: Bag Balm developed to soothe cows' udders [1].
